dish_conf_dir.description: Configuration directory for dish files (hosts, pass, etc.). If empty, defaults to $HOME/.dish.

user.description: Default remote user. Ignored if hosts include 'user@host' format.

timeout_per_host.description: Timeout per host (seconds) for command execution.

total_timeout.description: Total timeout for all hosts (seconds). Only relevant in sequential mode.

hosts_file.description: Path to file containing list of target hosts/accounts (one per line). Defaults to ~/.dish/hosts.

resting_hosts_file.description: Path to file containing hosts to exclude (resting hosts). Defaults to ~/.dish/rests.

password_file.description: Path to file with passwords (format: password:username:hostname). Defaults to ~/.dish/pass.

ignore_pass_perms.description: If true, ignore file permissions check on password file.

fork_mode.description: If true, run hosts in background (parallel mode).

log_file.description: File to append command output logs (shared across hosts).

host_log_base.description: Base name for per-host log files (e.g., 'dish_log' → 'dish_log_user@host.log').

journal.description: Path to command journal file for history. Defaults to ~/.dish/journal.

options_file.description: Path to file with default command-line options. Defaults to ~/.dish/options.

prompt_regex.description: Expected shell prompt regex after login (for telnet/mysql/etc.).

ssh_key_prompt_regex.description: Regex for SSH host key verification prompt.

ssh_key_answer.description: Response to SSH host key prompt.

force_tty.description: Force pseudo-TTY allocation (e.g., for `su` or interactive shells).

debug_mode.description: Enable dry-run mode: print env vars and commands, then exit.
